section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the current study, which investigated predictors of consideration of cosmetic surgery among female undergraduates. It highlights that body appreciation, media influence, and respondent weight status were significant predictors, with body appreciation being the strongest. The study also notes that BMI was a significant predictor, but in an unexpected direction (more slender participants reported greater consideration), and age was correlated but not a significant predictor. The section discusses limitations, such as the restricted range of BMI and age in the undergraduate sample, and suggests future research directions.
